v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Iacob autem * génuit Ioseph virum Maríæ; de qua natus est Iesus, qui vocátur Christus.
text.en: And Jacob * begot Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

text.la: Angelus Dómini * appáruit in somnis Ioseph, dicens: Ioseph, fili David, noli timére accípere Maríam cóniugem tuam; quod enim in ea natum est, de Spíritu Sancto est.
text.en: The angel of the Lord * appeared to Joseph in his sleep, saying: Joseph, son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife, for that which is conceived in her, is of the Holy Ghost.

text.la: Pastóres venérunt * festinántes, et invenérunt Maríam, et Ioseph, et Infántem pósitum in præsépio.
text.en: The shepherds came * with haste; and they found Mary and Joseph, and the infant lying in the manger.

text.la: Magi, intrántes domum, * invenérunt Púerum cum María, matre eius.
text.en: The Magi, entering into the house, * found the child with Mary his mother.

text.la: Erat Pater eius * et Mater mirántes super his quæ dicebántur de illo.
text.en: His father * and mother were wondering at those things which were spoken concerning him.

text.la: Descéndit Iesus cum María et Ioseph, et venit Názareth: et erat súbditus illis.
text.en: Jesus went down with Mary and Joseph, and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them.

v.la: Beáti qui hábitant in domo tua, Dómine.
v.en: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house, O Lord.

r.en: They shall praise thee for ever and ever.

text.la: Verbum caro * factum est, et habitávit in nobis, plenum grátiæ et veritátis; de cuius plenitúdine omnes nos accépimus, et grátiam pro grátia, allelúia.
text.en: The Word was made flesh, * and dwelt among us, full of grace and truth; and of his fulness we all have received, and grace for grace, alleluia.

text.la: Dómine Iesu Christe, qui, Maríæ et Ioseph súbditus, domésticam vitam ineffabílibus virtútibus consecrásti: fac nos, utriúsque auxílio, Famíliæ sanctæ tuæ exémplis ínstrui; et consórtium cónsequi sempitérnum:
text.en: Lord Jesus Christ, who subject to Mary and Joseph, didst consecrate family life by thy unspeakable virtues, aid us by their united intercession to profit by the examples of thy Holy Family, and attain to their everlasting companionship:
